summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via fetched Bun binary
details: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui@7.1.8 is advertised as a React chatbot UI component library. Its package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13, platform-detected zip) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the bun binary, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a ~727 KB file marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' whose contents are a heavily obfuscated bun-compiled bundle using a rotated string-array decoder (WV8StW / n7gIxM) and a scrambled-alphabet character-set decoder (hc1jfK9); the file's name has no relation to a chatbot UI. Installing the package causes an alternate (non-Node) runtime to be fetched and used specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload on the installer's host, which bypasses Node-based scanning and gives arbitrary code execution against the developer or build system performing the install. A UI component library has no legitimate need for a preinstall step that pulls a separate runtime to run an opaque bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
